sections.title: Section 1 · Course Registration
sections.scenario: A student calls a community learning centre to register for a course.

script.speaker: Speaker A
script.text: Good morning, Westbridge Community Learning Centre. How can I help?

script.speaker: Speaker B
script.text: Hello. I would like to register for the urban sketching course.

script.speaker: Speaker A
script.text: Certainly. May I have your full name?

script.speaker: Speaker B
script.text: It is Maya Chen. Chen is spelled C H E N.

script.speaker: Speaker A
script.text: The course begins on the fourteenth of September and runs on Tuesday evenings.

script.speaker: Speaker B
script.text: Tuesday is perfect. Which room is it in?

script.speaker: Speaker A
script.text: Room two hundred and four. The full fee is eighty-five pounds.

script.speaker: Speaker A
script.text: Please bring an A four sketchbook. Pencils are provided.

script.speaker: Speaker A
script.text: Finally, who should we contact in an emergency?

script.speaker: Speaker B
script.text: Daniel Chen. He is my brother.

questions.question: Which course does Maya choose?
questions.explanation: Maya directly names the urban sketching course.
questions.evidence: I would like to register for the urban sketching course.

questions.question: Family name: ____
questions.explanation: The caller spells her family name after giving her full name.
questions.evidence: It is Maya Chen. Chen is spelled C H E N.

questions.question: Course start date: ____
questions.explanation: The coordinator gives the course start date.
questions.evidence: The course begins on the fourteenth of September.

questions.question: On which day is the class held?
questions.explanation: The class runs on Tuesday evenings.
questions.evidence: It runs on Tuesday evenings.

questions.question: Room number: ____
questions.explanation: The room number is stated immediately after Maya asks.
questions.evidence: Room two hundred and four.

questions.question: The complete course fee is ____ pounds.
questions.explanation: The coordinator states the full fee.
questions.evidence: The full fee is eighty-five pounds.

questions.question: What must Maya bring?
questions.explanation: Pencils are supplied, but students must bring a sketchbook.
questions.evidence: Please bring an A four sketchbook. Pencils are provided.

questions.question: Emergency contact: ____
questions.explanation: Maya names her brother as the emergency contact.
questions.evidence: Daniel Chen. He is my brother.

sections.title: Section 2 · Library Orientation
sections.scenario: A librarian explains facilities and rules to a new student.

script.speaker: Speaker A
script.text: Welcome to Northbank Library. The help desk is on the first floor, opposite the main stairs.

script.speaker: Speaker B
script.text: Is there somewhere completely quiet for individual study?

script.speaker: Speaker A
script.text: Yes. Quiet room three B is beside the history collection.

script.speaker: Speaker A
script.text: Group rooms must be booked forty-eight hours in advance.

script.speaker: Speaker A
script.text: Ordinary books can be borrowed for fourteen days and renewed twice online.

script.speaker: Speaker B
script.text: Where can I print my assignments?

script.speaker: Speaker A
script.text: The printers are beside the east staircase.

script.speaker: Speaker A
script.text: A research skills workshop begins at four p m this Friday.

script.speaker: Speaker A
script.text: If the fire alarm sounds, leave by the nearest exit and meet at the garden gate.

questions.question: Where is the help desk?
questions.explanation: The librarian locates the desk on the first floor.
questions.evidence: The help desk is on the first floor.

questions.question: Individual study room: ____
questions.explanation: The designated quiet room is identified by number and letter.
questions.evidence: Quiet room three B is beside the history collection.

questions.question: Book group rooms ____ hours before use.
questions.explanation: The booking period is forty-eight hours.
questions.evidence: Group rooms must be booked forty-eight hours in advance.

questions.question: How long is the ordinary book loan?
questions.explanation: Ordinary books have a fourteen-day loan period.
questions.evidence: Ordinary books can be borrowed for fourteen days.

questions.question: Maximum online renewals: ____
questions.explanation: A loan may be renewed twice online.
questions.evidence: Renewed twice online.

questions.question: Printers are beside the ____ staircase.
questions.explanation: The directional detail distinguishes the printer location.
questions.evidence: The printers are beside the east staircase.

questions.question: When does the workshop begin?
questions.explanation: The librarian gives both the hour and weekday.
questions.evidence: A research skills workshop begins at four p m this Friday.

questions.question: Fire assembly point: the ____
questions.explanation: Everyone must meet at the garden gate after evacuation.
questions.evidence: Meet at the garden gate.

sections.title: Section 1 · Field Trip Briefing
sections.scenario: A tutor briefs a student about a coastal field trip.

script.speaker: Speaker A
script.text: For Saturday's field trip, meet at the main entrance of Riverside Station at seven forty-five.

script.speaker: Speaker B
script.text: What time does the train leave?

script.speaker: Speaker A
script.text: At eight ten from platform six, so please do not be late.

script.speaker: Speaker A
script.text: The coast may be windy. Bring a waterproof jacket rather than an umbrella.

script.speaker: Speaker A
script.text: You also need a packed lunch and a notebook. We will provide the measuring equipment.

script.speaker: Speaker B
script.text: Who is leading our group?

script.speaker: Speaker A
script.text: Doctor Priya Shah. She will meet you on the platform.

script.speaker: Speaker A
script.text: We expect to return to Riverside Station at six thirty in the evening.

questions.question: Meeting place: main entrance of ____ Station
questions.explanation: The station name is included in the meeting instruction.
questions.evidence: Meet at the main entrance of Riverside Station.

questions.question: Meeting time: ____
questions.explanation: Students meet before the train departure time.
questions.evidence: At seven forty-five.

questions.question: When does the train leave?
questions.explanation: The tutor distinguishes departure from meeting time.
questions.evidence: At eight ten from platform six.

questions.question: Departure platform: ____
questions.explanation: The train leaves from platform six.
questions.evidence: From platform six.

questions.question: What should students wear or bring for the weather?
questions.explanation: The tutor recommends a jacket and rejects an umbrella.
questions.evidence: Bring a waterproof jacket rather than an umbrella.

questions.question: Students must supply lunch and a ____.
questions.explanation: Equipment is provided, but a notebook is not.
questions.evidence: You also need a packed lunch and a notebook.

questions.question: Group leader: Dr ____
questions.explanation: The tutor names the group leader.
questions.evidence: Doctor Priya Shah.

questions.question: What is the expected return time?
questions.explanation: The group expects to return at half past six.
questions.evidence: At six thirty in the evening.

sections.title: Section 2 · Rooftop Garden Research
sections.scenario: A researcher presents findings about rooftop gardens and urban heat.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.text: Today's seminar examines how rooftop gardens affect urban heat.

script.speaker: Speaker A
script.text: Our team monitored twelve office buildings during the summer.

script.speaker: Speaker A
script.text: Temperature sensors recorded a reading every ten minutes.

script.speaker: Speaker A
script.text: North-facing green roofs were on average two point four degrees cooler than bare roofs.

script.speaker: Speaker B
script.text: Did the depth of the soil make a difference?

script.speaker: Speaker A
script.text: Yes. A minimum soil depth of twenty centimetres retained moisture most reliably.

script.speaker: Speaker A
script.text: We were surprised to record many wild bees, even on buildings near busy roads.

script.speaker: Speaker A
script.text: The main limitation was the short six-week study period.

script.speaker: Speaker A
script.text: The next phase will collect winter data to compare seasonal performance.

questions.question: What is the main research topic?
questions.explanation: The opening sentence states the focus.
questions.evidence: How rooftop gardens affect urban heat.

questions.question: Number of monitored buildings: ____
questions.explanation: The sample consisted of twelve office buildings.
questions.evidence: Our team monitored twelve office buildings.

questions.question: Sensors recorded data every ____ minutes.
questions.explanation: The recording interval was ten minutes.
questions.evidence: Recorded a reading every ten minutes.

questions.question: Which roofs showed the reported cooling result?
questions.explanation: The finding is specifically about north-facing green roofs.
questions.evidence: North-facing green roofs were on average two point four degrees cooler.

questions.question: Average cooling difference: ____ degrees
questions.explanation: The measured difference was two point four degrees.
questions.evidence: Two point four degrees cooler than bare roofs.

questions.question: Recommended minimum soil depth: ____ cm
questions.explanation: Twenty centimetres retained moisture most reliably.
questions.evidence: A minimum soil depth of twenty centimetres.

questions.question: Which observation surprised the researchers?
questions.explanation: The team explicitly describes the bee records as surprising.
questions.evidence: We were surprised to record many wild bees.

questions.question: The next phase will collect ____ data.
questions.explanation: Winter observations will support seasonal comparison.
questions.evidence: The next phase will collect winter data.
